ValidationRule.description: last name/first name/title/Passenger Type are required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( OR( IF(text(Passenger_Type__c)!="", OR( Last_Name__c="", First_Name__c="", text(Title__c)="" ), false ) ), IF(text(INF_Passenger_Type__c)!="", OR( INF_Last_Name__c="", INF_First_Name__c="", text(INF_Title__c)="" ), false ), IF(text(Passenger_Type__c)="", OR( text(Title__c)!="", Last_Name__c!="", First_Name__c!="", text(Date_of_Birth__c)!="", text(Meal_Selection_All_Sector__c)!="", text(Meal_Selection_Departing_Only__c)!="", text(Meal_Selection_Returning_Only__c)!="", text(Special_Service_Departing__c)!="", text(Special_Service_Returning__c)!="", Special_Service_Description__c!="" ), false ), IF(text(INF_Passenger_Type__c)="", OR( text(INF_Title__c)!="", INF_Last_Name__c!="", INF_First_Name__c!="", text(INF_Date_of_Birth__c)!="", text(INF_Meal_Selection_All_Sector__c)!="", text(INF_Meal_Selection_Departing_Only__c)!="", text(INF_Meal_Selection_Returning_Only__c)!="" ), false ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 請填寫乘客資訊或嬰兒資訊，包含乘客類型、稱謂、姓氏、名字、生日(小孩或嬰兒才需要)
